subject: Incident: API errors & token spike — compensation request
messages:
From: Liam Harper <liam@streamline.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nair <procurement@streamline.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated 5xx + token inflation during peak window — ask

Hi Grace,

We saw a ~45 minute window this morning (08:10–08:55 PT) where our production requests returned 500s or stalled and our token consumption spiked unexpectedly. This impacted our checkout microflow and resulted in measurable revenue impact for two customers.

Priya is looping me in on procurement/contract channels — we need help documenting the incident and discussing a remediation gesture. For context: we've been in a pilot on the Growth plan (trial) — usage is still under the initial commit. We appreciate your team's responsiveness earlier; could Redwood consider a compensatory top-up (token credit) plus a short trial extension while we validate the post-incident behavior?

Attached: incident-log-20270402.csv (30MB, truncated) and a brief summary PDF.

Thanks,
Liam Harper
CTO, Streamline AI
liam@streamline.ai
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Repeated 5xx + token inflation during peak window — ask

Forwarding Streamline's note — they sent logs and want a token top-up + trial extension. Immediate asks: 1) confirm scope (how many requests failed, token delta), 2) propose a remediation package we can offer quickly (tokens + extension + dedicated support window), 3) flags from compliance/finance we need to include.

Karthik — can you pull the call-level totals & error rates for their project id? Hannah — draft a polite customer-facing package; prefer a simple numeric offer rather than open-ended. Soojin — if you can flag any prior credits for them and whether this is within our escalation authority.

Grace
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated 5xx + token inflation during peak window — ask

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 09:39, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai wrote:
> Forwarding Streamline's note — they sent logs and want a token top-up + trial extension.

Quick numbers from infra: during 08:10–08:55 PT their project id saw ~18k failed token attempts (500s) and an extra ~220k tokens billed due to retries and stalled streaming sessions. Error rate peaked at 22%. Root cause looks like a transient routing issue in us-west-2 combined with aggressive client-side retry behavior.

Suggested remediation package (internal proposal):
- 300k token top-up (one-off, non-expiring for 90 days)
- 14-day trial extension on Growth plan to allow re-run of workloads
- Assigned success engineer: 3x 1-hour office hours within next 30 days

This is conservative relative to the observed delta and gives the customer time to validate. Recommend getting Soojin/Finance sign-off on token value (~$1,800 equivalent).

Karthik
Senior SRE Liaison
Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated 5xx + token inflation during peak window — ask

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 10:12, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Suggested remediation package: 300k token top-up, 14-day trial extension, 3 office hours.

Grace — finance check: Streamline currently on trial (no prior credits). Token top-up of 300k maps to an internal list-value estimate of $1,750. For an escalation like this we can approve up to $2k equivalent at my delegation; anything above requires Hannah's sign-off (Head of Revenue Ops). I support the package but suggest we include a clause: tokens issued as account credit redeemable only against API usage, expires in 90 days.

If Hannah approves, I'll prepare the DocuSign amendment + internal billing note.

Soojin
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Liam Harper <liam@streamline.ai>, Priya Nair <procurement@streamline.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident: API errors & token spike — compensation request

Hi Liam, Priya — thank you for the incident log and for working with Grace's team. We take these incidents seriously and want to make this right.

Redwood's remediation package for the April 2 incident:
- One-time account credit: 300,000 tokens applied to Streamline AI (redeemable against API usage).
- Trial extension: 14 calendar days added to your Growth pilot window.
- Technical support: Three 1-hour office hours with a senior SRE to review client retry behavior and server-side mitigations.

Terms: the token credit is valid for 90 days from issuance and cannot be converted to cash. We'll prepare a brief amendment for signature; no change to list pricing or contract terms. Once the amendment is signed we'll post the credit and extend the trial.

If that works, please reply with a quick confirmation and I'll send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
